terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the MAP PMOS application. By using the application, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: 1. About MAP PMOS
paragraphs: MAP PMOS is an informational and screening-support application designed to help users understand and assess information related to PMOS.
The application does not replace medical consultation, diagnosis, or treatment by a qualified healthcare professional.

sections.title: 2. Medical Disclaimer
paragraphs: Any screening result, prediction, score, or information provided by MAP PMOS is for informational and screening purposes only and should not be considered a medical diagnosis.
Results may be affected by the accuracy and completeness of the information entered by the user. Users should consult a qualified healthcare professional for diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice.
MAP PMOS should not be used as the sole basis for making medical decisions.

sections.title: 3. User Information
paragraphs: Users may enter clinical, reproductive, hormonal, biochemical, ultrasound, lifestyle, and other relevant information into the application.
Users are responsible for ensuring that the information provided is accurate and complete.

sections.title: 4. Data and Privacy
paragraphs: MAP PMOS does not require users to create an account or log in.

User-provided information is not stored on MAP PMOS servers or retained by the Operator. Information entered into the application remains subject to the application's technical operation and the user's device settings.
For further information regarding data handling and privacy, please refer to the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.

sections.title: 5. Use of the Application
paragraphs: The application must be used only for its intended purpose. Users must not attempt to misuse, modify, reverse engineer, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access to the application or its underlying systems.

sections.title: 6. Accuracy and Availability
paragraphs: While reasonable efforts are made to maintain the accuracy and functionality of MAP PMOS, the Operator does not guarantee that the application will always be available, error-free, or accurate for every individual.

sections.title: 8. Changes to the Terms

privacy.subtitle: MAP PMOS Application
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how MAP PMOS handles information when you use the application.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: MAP PMOS does not require registration or login.

Information entered by you into the application may include health-related information such as clinical, reproductive, hormonal, biochemical, ultrasound, lifestyle, or other information required for the application's features.

sections.title: 2. How Your Information Is Used
paragraphs: Information entered into MAP PMOS is used to provide the application's features, including screening, assessment, summaries, and informational insights related to PCOS.
The information is not used by the Operator for advertising or unrelated purposes.

sections.title: 3. Data Storage
paragraphs: MAP PMOS does not store your health information on our servers and does not maintain a centralized user database.
The application does not require you to create an account. Information entered into the application is handled according to the application's technical design and may remain on your device.
The Operator cannot recover information that is deleted, lost, or becomes unavailable on your device.

sections.title: 4. Data Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal health information with third parties for advertising or marketing purposes.
If the application uses any third-party technical services in the future, their handling of information will be subject to their applicable privacy policies and will be disclosed where required.

sections.title: 5. Device Permissions
paragraphs: MAP PMOS may request device permissions required for specific features of the application. Permissions can be managed through your device settings.

sections.title: 6. Data Security
paragraphs: Reasonable technical measures are used to protect the application and information handled through it. However, no electronic system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Users are responsible for maintaining the security of their device.

sections.title: 7. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: MAP PMOS is not intended for use by individuals who are below the minimum age permitted under applicable law.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable legal requirements.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Any changes will be reflected in the updated version available through the application.
